batch: 8 (chs 56-66, Part III: restoration and the contrite)

units.characteristics: the outsider gathered in; the self-serving blind watchmen
units.gist: the foreigner ('the LORD will surely separate me') and eunuch ('I am a DRY TREE') given 'a name better than sons and daughters'; 'my house shall be called a HOUSE OF PRAYER FOR ALL PEOPLES'; against it the blind watchmen, 'silent dogs... turned to their own way, each to his own gain' - the excluded welcomed; the shepherds who serve only themselves

units.characteristics: the God who dwells with the contrite; healing the backslider; peace to far and near
units.gist: THE GEM - 'the One who is high and lifted up, who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy: I dwell in the high and holy place, AND ALSO WITH HIM WHO IS OF A CONTRITE AND LOWLY SPIRIT, to REVIVE the spirit of the lowly'; 'I have seen his ways, but I will HEAL him... PEACE, PEACE, to the far and to the near'; 'no peace for the wicked' - the high God dwelling with the low

units.characteristics: hollow worship vs the fast God chooses; the light that breaks forth
units.gist: THE GEM - 'why have we FASTED and you see it not?... in the day of your fast you seek YOUR OWN PLEASURE'; 'is not THIS the fast that I choose: to LOOSE THE BONDS of wickedness... to SHARE YOUR BREAD with the hungry, bring the homeless poor into your house'; 'THEN shall your LIGHT break forth like the dawn'; the Sabbath 'a DELIGHT' - worship measured by mercy, not ritual

units.characteristics: iniquity as separation from God; the confession; no intercessor, God's own arm
units.gist: GEM - 'the LORD's hand is not shortened... BUT YOUR INIQUITIES HAVE MADE A SEPARATION between you and your God, your sins have HIDDEN HIS FACE'; the honest confession 'we grope for the wall like the blind... our sins testify against us'; 'he saw that there was NO ONE TO INTERCEDE; then his OWN ARM brought him salvation' - sin as separation; God's self-provided rescue

units.characteristics: the risen light; the heart that thrills; mourning ended
units.gist: GEM - 'ARISE, SHINE, for your LIGHT has come, and the glory of the LORD has RISEN upon you'; 'you shall see and be radiant; your HEART SHALL THRILL AND EXULT'; 'the LORD will be your EVERLASTING LIGHT, and your days of MOURNING SHALL BE ENDED' - the darkened self flooded with light; joy replacing mourning

units.characteristics: the Spirit-anointed herald; ashes to beauty; the garments of salvation
units.gist: THE GEM - 'the SPIRIT of the Lord GOD is upon me... to bring GOOD NEWS TO THE POOR, to BIND UP THE BROKENHEARTED, to proclaim liberty to the captives... to COMFORT all who mourn; to give a beautiful headdress INSTEAD OF ASHES, the OIL OF GLADNESS instead of mourning, the GARMENT OF PRAISE instead of a FAINT SPIRIT'; 'my soul shall EXULT in my God, for he has clothed me with the GARMENTS OF SALVATION'

units.characteristics: the new name; God's delight; rejoicing over as a bridegroom
units.gist: GEM - 'you shall be called by a NEW NAME'; 'you shall no more be termed FORSAKEN... but you shall be called MY DELIGHT IS IN HER... for the LORD DELIGHTS IN YOU'; 'as the bridegroom REJOICES OVER THE BRIDE, so shall your God REJOICE OVER YOU' - the forsaken renamed as God's delight; God's joy over his people

units.characteristics: the God afflicted in their affliction; the grieved Spirit; the Father appealed to
units.gist: GEM - the warrior treading the winepress alone; then the recounting of steadfast love - 'IN ALL THEIR AFFLICTION HE WAS AFFLICTED... in his love and pity he redeemed them; he lifted them up and CARRIED them all the days of old'; 'they rebelled and GRIEVED HIS HOLY SPIRIT'; 'you are our FATHER'; 'why do you make us wander... harden our heart?'

units.characteristics: the longing for God to come; universal uncleanness; the clay before the potter
units.gist: GEM - 'oh that you would REND THE HEAVENS and come down'; 'no eye has seen a God besides you, who acts for those who WAIT for him'; 'we have all become like one who is UNCLEAN, and ALL OUR RIGHTEOUS DEEDS ARE LIKE A POLLUTED GARMENT; we all fade like a leaf'; 'we are the CLAY, and you are our potter; we are all the work of your hand' - the confession of total need; the clay's appeal

units.characteristics: the God who says Here I am to the unseeking; servants vs forsakers; the new creation
units.gist: GEM - 'I was ready to be SOUGHT by those who did not ask; I said, HERE I AM, HERE I AM, to a nation not called by my name'; the self-righteous 'I am too holy for you'; the SERVANTS eat/sing vs the forsakers hunger/wail; 'I create NEW HEAVENS and a new earth... be GLAD and REJOICE'; 'BEFORE THEY CALL I WILL ANSWER' - God seeking the unseeking; the two destinies; new creation

units.characteristics: the one God looks to: humble, contrite, trembling at his word; mother-comfort
units.gist: THE GEM (book's summit) - 'heaven is my throne... what house would you build for me?... but THIS IS THE ONE TO WHOM I WILL LOOK: he who is HUMBLE AND CONTRITE IN SPIRIT and TREMBLES AT MY WORD'; 'as one whom his MOTHER COMFORTS, so I will COMFORT you'; 'your heart shall rejoice; your bones shall flourish'; the new heavens remain - the interior God regards is the lowly, contrite, word-trembling one
